page: Microsoft Azure M96ds_2_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors, the instance delivers 96 dedicated virtual CPUs coupled with 1946.0 GB of RAM. This configuration yields a high memory density of approximately 20.27 GB per vCPU, placing it firmly within hyper-scale memory architectures designed to support very large data footprints in active memory without paging.

For local ephemeral operations, the instance bundles 429 GB of local SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. It operates without dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs. Network ingress and egress require user-allocated IP configurations, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included standard with the deployment.

From an efficiency perspective, the M96ds_2_v3 delivers high compute parallelism and high-capacity memory consolidation on a single node. The trade-off lies in its specialized allocation: the local SSD capacity is relatively modest at 429 GB, functioning primarily as temporary scratch space rather than persistent primary storage. Workloads deployed on this instance are typically suited for in-memory relational databases, massive enterprise caching layers, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, and high-memory analytics processing engines.
description: Microsoft Azure M96ds_2_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by Microsoft Hyper-V and an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. It offers 96 dedicated vCPUs and 1946.0 GB of system memory, delivering a generous memory density of 20.27 GB per vCPU. The instance is designed for hyper-scale enterprise applications requiring immense RAM footprints directly accessible to execution threads. Local ephemeral storage is provided via a bundled 429 GB SSD, and the platform supports Premium Storage for persistent I/O operations. Zero GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default. The platform offers extreme consolidation efficiency for high-memory, multi-threaded workloads, though local storage capacity is modest relative to overall system scale. Microsoft Azure M96ds_2_v3 is best suited for large-scale in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, enterprise ERP backends, and comprehensive data caching systems.
